recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future TestScript expression/path changes should be made in HL7/fhir-testing-ig, not by restoring TestScript source to the FHIR core repository.
issue_request: FHIR-51111 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It requested TestScript expression elements be updated to the Expression data type, expression language support be documented, and existing path elements be deprecated rather than removed.
initial_application: Core commit ba91e922ce318538784226167ba47b70cf786729, merged through HL7/fhir#3508, applied FHIR-51111 while TestScript was still in core by adding TestScript.fixture.expression, changing the relevant variable/assert expression elements from string to Expression, deprecating TestScript.variable.path, compareToSourcePath, and assert.path, and updating examples to use nested Expression values.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2025-06-23 record the 12-0-0 vote. Later commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan from core and added a Testing IG reference. Current core source has no active TestScript resource in source/fhir.ini, while ballot-intro links TestScript to the FHIR Testing IG. The current HL7/fhir-testing-ig source and continuous build include TestScript as an R6 additional resource and preserve the FHIR-51111 Expression-typed elements and deprecated path elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Re-adding or editing source/testscript in core would be wrong because TestScript is no longer in the current core build scope.
